name: SONAT South Sys Expansion II Phase 2
monitor_reason: length: EIA-only 41 mi, contradicted by the FERC-approved total; also a completed 2003 loop of an operating system, not a pending project
researcher_notes: EIA August 2026 release, sheet Historical Projects (1996-2024), Excel row 288, lists SONAT South Sys Expansion II Phase 2 by Southern Natural Gas Co as Completed June 2003, FERC docket CP02-01, 41 mi, 86 million dollars, 195.9 MMcf/d, 20 and 36 inch, in MS, AL, SC and GA. A Natural Gas Intelligence article on the FERC approval describes the whole South System Expansion as about 67 miles of looping and 53,900 horsepower, with Phase II adding 196 MMcf/d. EIA lists Phases 1, 1A, 2 and 3 at 67.8, 24, 41 and 46.4 mi, which adds to about 179 mi against that 67 mi total, so the 41 mi figure is not reliable. The mileage is not stated in any second source for Phase 2 alone. The line is already part of the operating Southern Natural Gas system, which has its own row P0252, and this is a finished 2003 project, not a proposal. No new row recommended. The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission approved major projects page did not load with the docket number, so it is not cited. Only EIA is a validated source for the length; the news article does not state the Phase 2 length.
